sizing.method: GET /events?series_ticker=<X>&status=settled&min_close_ts=1785369600&limit=200, one page per candidate series (EventData carries no result or price field per the OpenAPI schema, so this counts settled events without reading any outcome). Counted before any /markets or /markets/trades call was made against the candidate series.
sizing.chosen_reason: Four series discovered from GET /series?include_volume=true (the primary category/frequency/volume_fp metadata, no per-market data): three same-product daily temperature ladders (fee_type quadratic, fee_multiplier 1) and one daily FX range ladder (also quadratic, multiplier 1), all with a full settled-event history back to the historical/live cutoff and none returning zero events (unlike study 0001). Candidates not chosen: KXAAAGASD (gas price) uses a non-mutually-exclusive cumulative-threshold ladder, a different mechanism than the mutually-exclusive brackets of the chosen four, so it is left out to keep the population mechanism homogeneous; KXEURUSD was dropped only to keep the estimated population comfortably inside the request budget, not for any outcome-based reason.

listing.slice: one series_ticker at a time, min_settled_ts/max_settled_ts spanning the whole window (no daily slicing: per-series volume is small enough not to need it)

split.train: event whose every market has settlement_ts < S
split.test: event whose every market has decision_ts >= S

primary.metric: mean over pooled-bin markets of s*(y - p), s=-1 low bin, s=+1 high bin

secondary.candidate: p' = sigmoid(a * logit(p)), a fit on train by minimizing mean Brier, golden section on [0.25, 4.0], 100 iterations
secondary.metric: held-out mean Brier, raw minus candidate, event-clustered bootstrap CI

economics.fee_model_UNVERIFIED: fee_multiplier * 0.07 * p * (1 - p) per contract for quadratic* fee types, 0 while fee_waiver_expiration_time > decision_ts
economics.min_useful_effect: mean over pooled-bin markets of (fee_model(p) + execution_allowance)

decision_rule.PROMOTE: events >= 100 AND CI lower > MUE AND fee schedule verified from an official Kalshi document AND held-out Brier(candidate) < Brier(raw) AND all validation and leakage checks pass
